rationale.automation-bias: Developers over-trust outputs, approve unread code, and risk skill atrophy.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Generated volume creates exhausting, sometimes infeasible, continuous human review.
rationale.oversight-theater: Practitioners approve pull requests they do not understand or inspect.
rationale.quality-debt: Practitioners report technical debt, unmaintainability, bugs, and poor structure.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Practitioners report concrete insecure generation, including plaintext password storage.
rationale.ai-review: Practitioners delegate production-readiness audits of generated code to reasoning models.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Practitioners use tests and execution to verify generated behavior.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Line-by-line review and manual validation provide human checkpoints.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Version control and change logs bound chaotic, unauthorized multi-file changes.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent AI change logs and version control support review and rollback.
rationale.survey-input: Substantive findings characterize usage contexts, trust, review preferences, and concerns.
rationale.steering: Prompting, context documents, planning, and task decomposition are substantive practices.
rationale.non-developer: The study includes non-programmers and analyzes lowered development barriers.
rationale.assistive: Practitioners use frequent, human-initiated conversational generation and refinement.
rationale.agentic: AI leads decisions and produces complete applications or large multi-file changes.
rationale.risk-security: Security receives focal analysis supported by a concrete vulnerability report.
rationale.risk-quality: The study reports debt, bugs, maintainability problems, and structural degradation.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Trust, unread approvals, dependency, and skill erosion receive focal analysis.
rationale.method-self-report: Semi-structured interviews elicited practitioners’ experiences, practices, and perceptions.
rationale.method-mining: Researchers qualitatively mined thousands of practitioner posts and comments.
